findings.detail: Rendered prose preserves identical premise specification, surface-form difference, approximate lengths, values, and frozen near-zero/moderate classifications with the required article and answer qualifications.
Rendered prose states the removal question and distinguishes it from scoring the content-matched sources.
Methods prose gives the dose-matched removal-and-retraining definition and per-source-effect setup, including per-seed controls.
Scope is explicitly limited to gradient-based attribution and does not generalize the verdict to retrieval or embedding methods.
Rendered methods prose preserves the exploratory status, absorption interpretation, netting and mediation limitation, diagnostic checkpoint treatment, and fixed-table authority.
Rendered prose explicitly restricts two-seed replication to declared seed-paired families and separately labels single-seed/instrument-specific readings.

Rendered scope/checkpoint prose correctly identifies factory_farming, attrib_mix_v4, qwen3-4b, seed 42, checkpoint-23 for attrib_mix_v4 arms, checkpoint-24 for m0_multiform arms, and avoids unavailable identifiers.
Values, full-fine-tuning denominator scope, overlapping intervals, seed pairing, and no-LoRA-halving qualification are preserved.
Single-seed seed-42 machinery value and zero-straddling interval are correctly rendered with the stated control qualification.
Both 20% oracle values, zero-excluding intervals, separately measured per-source-effect selection, and the budget-limited removability interpretation are preserved.
Both 10% TracIn values and negative zero-excluding intervals are correctly rendered; the same-budget oracle values and straddling intervals plus the no-budget-ordering qualification are retained.
TracIn-cosine values and interval statuses are correct, single-seed qualification is preserved, and the same-budget oracle qualification is retained.
Both opposite-sign 10% delta-predictability estimates and zero-excluding intervals are correctly rendered as an unresolved seed contradiction, not an average or working repair.
Both 20% delta-predictability values and zero-straddling intervals are correct, with the qualification that the wider budget does not resolve the 10% contradiction.
Both 20% TracIn values and zero-straddling intervals are correctly rendered within the seed-paired family.
Both 20% TracIn-cosine values and zero-straddling intervals are correctly rendered within the seed-paired family.
Rendered prose names all three methods and states interval overlap in every declared budget-by-seed cell, while explicitly disclaiming pairwise significance because no pairwise contrast was computed.

Rendered limitation prose preserves the retriever identity, chunking/max and mean-over-chunks details, six-source polarity scope, exact correlations, length correlation range, rank-correlation—not-AF distinction, no-removal limitation, and bounded verdict.
Rendered prose identifies +0.3111 as a recorded explicit-stance positive-control contrast, lower-dose ceiling, derived from arm scores without an inferred interval, and not general belief transfer.
Rendered prose reports the descriptive-conclusion corpus value +0.1106 with its matched-dose qualification.
